crossRefs.note: When the woman of Tekoa spoke to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, showed respect, and said, “Help, O king!”
What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for…
A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’
crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, saying, “Help, my lord, O king!”
translations.bsb: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried out to him, “Help me, my lord the king!”
translations.kjv: And as the king of Israel was passing by upon the wall, there cried a woman unto him, saying, Help, my lord, O king.
translations.asv: And as the king of Israel was passing by upon the wall, there cried a woman unto him, saying, Help, my lord, O king.
